attchmntText: Himatsingka Seide Limited has informed the Exchange about subject to approval of  RBI, capitalization of a portion of receivables of Himatsingka America Inc., USA, wholly owned step-down subsidiary in the books of the Company.
voiceSummary: Himatsingka Seide Limited board approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations was 62,452.43 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Profit after tax was 1,420.20 lakhs for the quarter. Earnings per share were 1.13 for the quarter. The board also approved capitalization of receivables from Himatsingka America Inc., USA, subject to Reserve Bank of India approval. This transaction involves up to USD 50.06 Million. Himatsingka America Inc. is a wholly owned step-down subsidiary. The company is in the home textiles industry. The meeting was held on November 14, 2026.

attchmntText: Himatsingka Seide Limited has submitted to the Exchange the Unaudited Financial Results (Consolidated and Standalone) of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, along with the respective Limited Review Reports issued by the Statutory Auditors of the Company and Statement of disclosures of line items pursuant to Regulation 52(4) of the SEBI Listing Regulations and are enclosed herewith.
voiceSummary: Himatsingka Seide Limited Board of Directors approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board also approved capitalizing a portion of receivables from Himatsingka America Inc., subject to Reserve Bank of India approval. Consolidated revenue from operations for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, was 62,452.43 lacs, with a profit after tax of 1,420.20 lacs. Earnings per share were 1.13 for the quarter. For the six months ended September 30, 2026, consolidated revenue from operations was 1,24,582.70 lacs, with a profit after tax of 1,918.93 lacs. Earnings per share were 1.53 for the six-month period. The meeting was held on November 14, 2026.

attchmntText: Himatsingka Seide Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 35000 Series 2 Listed Non-Convertible Debentures.
voiceSummary: Himatsingka Seide Limited has allotted 35,000 Series 2 Non-Convertible Debentures on November 13, 2026. The issuance is a private placement aggregating Rs. 35,00,00,000. Each debenture has a face value of Rs. 10,000. The securities are senior, secured, rated, listed, redeemable, transferable, and non-convertible. They carry a coupon rate of 11.50% per annum, payable quarterly. The tenure is 42 months from the deemed date of allotment. The maturity date is May 13, 2030. Principal repayment occurs in three instalments at the end of 30, 36, and 42 months. The debentures are listed on BSE Limited. Security includes a charge over identified land and building in Hassan Growth Centre Industrial Area, Karnataka, and a charge over the Subscription Escrow Account.
